plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the tenth season of , Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl, in and ( ).

==Volume releases==
Three Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl DVD box sets were released by VIZ Media in 2008 and 2009, containing the whole season between them. There are three boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-17===
 
Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl - Box Set 1 was released by VIZ Media on September 16, 2008. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBS1.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 2: Episodes 18-34===
 
Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl - Box Set 2 was released by VIZ Media on November 4, 2008. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined (despite the box stating that it contains 18 episodes). Its catalogue number is DPMDPBS2.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 3: Episodes 35-51===
 
Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl - Box Set 3 was released by VIZ Media on March 17, 2009. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBS3.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series: Diamond and Pearl Complete Collection on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on August 20, 2019 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 51 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000081483. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.
